Sub-question: SQ1 Authoring. What does an admin need from a platform to capture a lesson’s content, sequence and delivery instructions, so that it can be run without them in the room?
How it is answered: Design of the block-based authoring model; a check that it can represent lessons from real curricula; testing of the worksheet generator on sample lessons; the time taken to build a lesson

Sub-question: SQ2 Delivery. How can the platform control who delivers a lesson and guide them through it, so that delivery follows the admin’s design?
How it is answered: Design of approval, roles and the walkthrough; technical tests of the role and lesson-flow rules; a heuristic review of the interface; informal feedback

Sub-question: SQ3 Fit. How well does the platform meet the needs identified in the literature and by practitioners, and how does it differ from existing systems?
How it is answered: Assessment against the six criteria from Chapter 3; a benchmark against existing systems; informal feedback from practitioners
